pretreatments.description: Low-temperature thermal treatment at temperatures between 50 °C and 80 °C for durations ranging from 15 to 90 minutes. This method involves submerging the sludge samples in a thermostatic water bath, sealing them in 500-mL stainless steel tubes, and monitoring the temperature rise to the predefined value before initiating treatment. The treatment duration was measured from the time the sludge samples first reached the target temperature. After treatment, the tubes were immediately immersed in cold water to rapidly lower the temperature back to 33 °C for subsequent anaerobic digestion.
